=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh: lines 147-151 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The unsafe ledger-path case exits 1 without writing `staged_support_rebase_conflict=true` or `staged_support_rebase_conflict_files=$path` to `$GITHUB_OUTPUT`.
  WHY: The workflow's dedicated rejection handler at implement.yml:3968 activates only when `steps.commit_changes.outputs.staged_support_rebase_conflict != ''`, so the unsafe-path failure falls through to generic post-Codex diagnose/re-issue handling instead of the intended `ai:needs-human` halt, issue comment, and CRITICAL Telegram alert; the test at line 1736 discards GITHUB_OUTPUT and does not assert the output variables.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml: lines 3207, 3303, and the staging step at lines 930-1278 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The preflight scope guard reads `git diff --cached --name-only` from a temporary index built by `git add -u` before staged-support restore, and the self-repo exclusions contain no `scripts/`, `prompts/`, or `ai-memory/schemas/` exclusions.
  WHY: A self-repo implement run on a divergent integration branch with `ENFORCE_FILES_TOUCHED=true` and a narrow `files_touched:` allowlist can misidentify staged-support overwrites as out-of-scope changes and block before "Commit changes" can restore them.
- Requirement: From the PR description — "An unavailable ledger or baseline, unreadable branch blob, or merge conflict emits `IMPLEMENT_STAGED_SUPPORT_REBASE_CONFLICT` or a more specific staged-support error, sets `staged_support_rebase_conflict=true` with `staged_support_rebase_conflict_files`, and fails closed. The dedicated rejection handler labels the issue `ai:needs-human`, posts the affected paths, sends a CRITICAL Telegram alert when configured, and suppresses generic diagnose/re-issue handling."
  Expected change site: scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh, lines 147-151, before the `exit 1` in the unsafe-path case
  Evidence of absence: Lines 147-151 exit 1 without writing `staged_support_rebase_conflict=true` or `staged_support_rebase_conflict_files` to `$GITHUB_OUTPUT`. The two other rejection paths at lines 126-135 and 136-141 do emit both output variables. The test `test_commit_helper_rejects_unsafe_staged_support_ledger_paths` at line 1736 discards `$GITHUB_OUTPUT` (`_github_output`) and asserts only exit code and error message. PR review comment entry[5] (Copilot, 2026-09-12) explicitly flagged this gap and the most recent autofix run did not close it.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- Requirement: From the PR description — "the staging step snapshots ... and records every tracked file it overwrote" and the implementation must prevent staging artifacts from affecting scope enforcement; the Copilot review comment entry[4] asked to "Add the ledger paths to the preflight exclusions (or project the restored worktree into the temporary index) and add a regression test for a self-repo staged-support run with an allowlist."
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/implement.yml, in the preflight destructive-commit guard step (lines 3292-3358), either (a) excluding STAGED_SUPPORT_LEDGER paths from the staged set passed to the scope guard, or (b) restoring the staged-support worktree before building the preflight temp index, or (c) adding a regression test exercising a self-repo run with `ENFORCE_FILES_TOUCHED=true` and a narrow `files_touched:` allowlist when staging overwrites tracked helpers.
  Evidence of absence: The preflight at line 3303 reads `git diff --cached` from a temp index containing staging-overwritten helpers. No step between "Stage workflow support files" and "Preflight destructive-commit guard" restores those files or filters them from the staged set. The `add_u_excludes` for `is_self_repo=true` at line 3181 does not include `scripts/`, `prompts/`, or `ai-memory/schemas/`. No line in the preflight references `STAGED_SUPPORT_LEDGER`, `STAGED_SUPPORT_BASE_DIR`, or any staged-support path exclusion. The commit-time guard inside `implement_commit_changes.sh` handles this correctly because the restore block runs first, but the preflight has no equivalent protection. PR review comment entry[4] (Copilot, 2026-09-12) flagged this gap.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
